Plastic without oil, from the Fermenter's Ethanol, all in the Chemical Reactor.
# Ethylene
- 100 mB Ethanol + 5 mB Sulfuric Acid (the catalyst) make 60 mB Ethylene (a gas) and 40 mB Water.
- The Water goes into the reactor's by-product tank and leaves by By-product faces.
# Plastic Sheet
- 120 mB Ethylene make 2 Plastic Sheets (bio-polyethylene). The Light Oil + Hydrogen recipe still works.

# PVC Sheet
- 60 mB Ethylene + 60 mB Chlorine make 2 PVC Sheets.
- Hardened and Arcforged Fluid Conduits and Fluid Tanks take one, an acid-proof lining.
# #arcforge:plastics
Plastic Sheet and PVC Sheet are both plastics: every recipe that took Plastic Sheet takes either.
